general.domain: NHL player, team, contract, city and agency analytics
rules: Use only tables and columns provided in schema.json.
Never invent a table or column.
Prefer the LLM dataset views over underlying source datasets.
Use playerId as the canonical player identifier.
Use teamId as the canonical team identifier.
Use teamCode and teamName for display and entity resolution, but prefer teamId for joins.
If all required columns exist in one table, query that table directly without unnecessary joins.
Never join a table to itself unless the question genuinely requires a self-join.
Do not infer relationships from similar-looking names when a canonical ID relationship is available.
Do not interpret rankings or similarity scores using arbitrary qualitative thresholds.
A lower rank number means a better rank unless a table definition explicitly states otherwise.
Do not join LLM.Team solely to identify or filter a team when the target table already contains teamId, teamCode or teamName. Filter the target table directly.

player_required: Questions referring to me, my, myself or the user's own NHL career or situation.
Player-specific destination questions such as 'Where is best for me?'.
Player-specific contract value, comparable, team-fit or affordability questions.
team_or_city_required: Questions using contextual terms such as there, that team or that city when no team or city has been established.
behaviour: If a question requires a player and no player has been established, ask which player before generating SQL.
If a question requires a team and no team has been established, ask which team before generating SQL.
If a question requires a city and no city or associated team has been established, ask which city or team before generating SQL.
Reuse an established player, team or city from conversation context until the user changes it.
League-wide questions do not require a player, team or city.

LLM.Player.description: Canonical NHL player identity, biography, current team, draft information and career totals.

LLM.PlayerPerformance.description: Current analytical performance snapshot used by the player comparison model.

important_definitions.latestSeasonPPG: Points per game in the latest season.
important_definitions.latestSeasonGPG: Goals per game in the latest season.
important_definitions.latestSeasonAPG: Assists per game in the latest season.
important_definitions.latestSeasonAvgTOI: Average time on ice in the latest season.
important_definitions.ppgGrowth: Change in points-per-game performance used to represent trajectory.
important_definitions.toiGrowth: Change in average time on ice used to represent trajectory.

LLM.PlayerComparables.grain: One row per target player and comparable player combination.
query_rules: For overall comparable questions order by comparable_rank ascending.
For playing-style questions order by playing_style_similarity descending.
For production questions order by production_similarity descending.
For effectiveness questions order by effectiveness_similarity descending.
For usage questions order by usage_similarity descending.
For trajectory questions order by trajectory_similarity descending.
Higher similarity values indicate greater similarity.
Do not assign arbitrary high, medium or low labels to similarity values.

LLM.PlayerContracts.description: Historical NHL contracts linked to canonical NHL players and performance around the time of signing.

LLM.TeamRoster.description: Current NHL roster and depth-chart information linked to canonical players and teams.
LLM.TeamRoster.grain: One row per player-team roster entry.
query_rules: Position values may contain multiple comma-separated positions such as "C,LW". When matching a player's position to roster players, treat each comma-separated position independently rather than requiring exact equality.

When answering questions about current positional competition, lineup competition or following up on LLM.PlayerTeamFit.playersAtPosition, filter isDepthChart = TRUE so the result is consistent with the playersAtPosition definition.

LLM.TeamCap.description: Current NHL team salary-cap position and roster composition.

LLM.TeamOrganisation.description: NHL team organisation, leadership, affiliate and qualitative organisation information.

LLM.TeamTravel.description: NHL team travel workload for a season.
LLM.TeamTravel.grain: One row per team and season.
query_rules: Use the most recent season when the user asks about current travel without specifying a season.
distanceRank of 1 represents the highest total travel distance, not the least travel.

LLM.City.description: Canonical NHL team home-city and geographic information.
LLM.City.grain: One row per current NHL team location.

LLM.CityTax.description: High-level tax environment for each NHL team location with league comparisons.
LLM.CityTax.grain: One row per NHL team location.
use_for: Federal and state or provincial tax
query_rules: These rates describe the location's tax environment and are not an estimate of a specific player's actual tax liability.
Do not treat top marginal tax rates as effective tax rates.
Player-specific take-home pay requires the separate schedule-based tax model.

LLM.CityClimate.description: Climate characteristics of NHL team locations with league comparisons.
LLM.CityClimate.grain: One row per NHL team location.

LLM.CityCostOfLiving.description: Cost-of-living indices for NHL team locations with league comparisons.
LLM.CityCostOfLiving.grain: One row per NHL team location.

LLM.PlayerCurrentContract.description: Current NHL player contract and cap information linked to canonical player and team identifiers.
LLM.PlayerCurrentContract.grain: One row per current NHL player.
use_for: Whether another team has enough cap space for a player's current cap hit
query_rules: Use this table instead of LLM.PlayerContracts when the question is specifically about a player's current contract or current cap hit.
Use LLM.PlayerContracts for historical contracts and contract-at-signing analysis.
For a basic affordability question, compare the player's current capHit with the destination team's relevant cap-space measure from LLM.TeamCap.
Do not join LLM.PlayerContracts merely to obtain a player's current cap hit.

LLM.PlayerTeamFit.description: Player-by-team destination analysis combining current contract affordability, positional roster competition, tax, cost of living, climate and travel.
LLM.PlayerTeamFit.grain: One row per player and potential destination team.
use_for: Comparing potential teams for a player
Which teams can currently afford a player

important_definitions.currentCapGap: Destination team's current cap space minus the player's current cap hit. Positive means sufficient current cap space before considering roster moves or other transactions.
important_definitions.projectedCapGap: Destination team's projected cap space minus the player's current cap hit.
important_definitions.canAffordCurrent: Whether current cap space is at least the player's current cap hit.
important_definitions.canAffordProjected: Whether projected cap space is at least the player's current cap hit.
important_definitions.playersAtPosition: Number of current depth-chart players listed at the same position as the player. This is a crude roster competition measure and should not by itself be interpreted as opportunity.
important_definitions.incomeTaxRank: League ranking from the city tax data.
important_definitions.affordabilityRank: League affordability ranking from cost-of-living data.
important_definitions.sunshineRank: League sunshine ranking from climate data.
important_definitions.distanceRank: League ranking for total travel distance.

query_rules: Use this table as the primary source for player-specific destination questions.
Do not describe a destination as objectively the best team using these fields alone.
Do not create an overall fit score unless explicit weighting rules have been supplied.
When asked where is best for a player without stated priorities, compare relevant dimensions and explain the trade-offs.
Treat playersAtPosition only as a basic roster competition indicator, not a definitive measure of playing opportunity.
canAffordCurrent and canAffordProjected represent cap-space comparisons only. They do not account for trades, buyouts, LTIR, retained salary, roster moves or other cap-management mechanisms.
Do not treat topMarginalIncomeTaxRate as the player's actual effective tax rate.
